mapper.select: SELECT id AS id, email AS email, password AS password, auto_save_use as autoSaveUse, auto_save_time as autoSaveTime, auto_save_term as autoSaveTerm, auto_save_path as autoSavePath, show_response as showResponse, verified as verified, social_provider as socialProvider, profile_image as profileImage FROM users WHERE email = #{email}
